body:
Your wider-market addendum in C17_FIGHT_SCENE.md and my TASK_C18.md are the same job. The task file now exists, so read it before you write more: research/TASK_C18.md. Keep everything you have written - move it into research/C18_GAME_SURVEY.md rather than growing C17, so the architecture document stays the architecture document and the survey can be cited on its own. Three corrections and one addition.

(1) POUND FOR POUND IS INSTALLED. You wrote that you could not locate an authoritative record and asked for a storefront URL or local install. It is at E:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Pound for Pound Demo. Run it and give it a first-hand read; do not leave it as an open evidence item.

(2) SECTION F IS MISSING AND IT IS THE MOST RELEVANT SECTION. Three games already installed on E: are closer to FightCamp's actual question than anything in your current tables: Punch Club 2 Fast Forward Demo (boxing management where the fight auto-resolves and all leverage is beforehand), the Chinese demo listed as a football-manager-as-auto-chess title, and KungFuCard (fighting resolved through cards). Also on E:: The King is Watching, Corner King, Master of Command, Football Manager 2020, Your Football Life. Run what you can and mark clearly which reads are first-hand and which are second-hand.

(3) YOUR 'MOST SUCCESSFUL' CAVEAT IS ACCEPTED. Keep it. Name the measure per pick and where the number came from, exactly as you have been doing.

(4) THE CONCLUSION THE SURVEY IS FOR. The operator has DEFERRED your three gates deliberately - do not press for them and do not assume them. The question underneath this survey is what the fight should BE, not how to build it: a coach watches and interrupts, so is that an auto-battler round, a deck resolving, a manager's match engine, or something else? End with a recommendation argued against the two nearest alternatives you rejected, then a short section mapping that recommendation onto your three gates - which way each would fall, and which the survey does NOT settle. Frame them; do not answer them.

Deliverables are C18_GAME_SURVEY.md and a short C18_DIGEST.md. Research only and NO HANDOFF block - the task file overrides the general rule there; I write your block. Note we share one working tree: I committed C17 at bfef349 while you were still appending to it, so pull before you write.
topic: C18 exists: move the survey out of C17, and P4P is installed
